arabic text: Islam ki azmat ka Ay baagh-e-sunehra
english translation text: O golden garden of Islam's greatness

arabic text: Sadqe me tere bibi abad har ek anghan Saye me tere bibi\nshiyyat ka jahaan roshan Kirdaar tera bibi Duniya me ye\ngehraa
english translation text: Through your grace, every courtyard is inhabited Beneath your shade\nthe world of Shia Islam is illuminated Your character, O Lady has left\na profound mark upon the world

arabic text: Panjetan ka wasila hi imaan hai takat hai bibi ki ghulami hi ik\nsayaa-e-rehmat hai Roshan hai har ek dil ka Ujra huwa\nsehra
english translation text: The intercession of the Panjetan is faith and strength Servitude to the Lady is itself\na shade of mercy Even every desolate desert of the heart\nis illuminated

arabic text: Baba bhi mila aisa waris jo risalat ka Shohar bhi mila aisa wo\nfakr-e-shuja'at ka Beto ka hai is din se Rishta bhara gehra
english translation text: You received a father who was the inheritor of Prophethood And a husband who was\nthe pride of courage From this day, the bond with your sons became deeply rooted

arabic text: Shiyo ka saharaa hai shabbir ka ye matam Har cheez se\nbadkar hai sadat ke ghar ka gham Darte nahi ham chahe\nSocho ke ho pehra
english translation text: The mourning of Shabbir is the support of the Shia Above all things\nis the grief of the Sayyids' household We do not fear, even if\nthere are a hundred guards

arabic text: Sadme jo sahe tune wo likh hi nahi sakhte Bibi ke masaaib to\nham keh bhi nahi sakte Ta hashr karenge ham Matam tera\nzehra
english translation text: The sorrows you endured cannot truly be written The Lady's calamities\ncannot even be fully spoken Until Judgement Day we will perform your mourning\nO Zahra

arabic text: Ummat na samaj payi tazeem risalat ko Darbaro me layi hai\ntathir ki waris ko Hai baagh-e-fiddak ab bhi Bas naam tere\nzehra
english translation text: The nation did not understand the honour due to Prophethood It brought\nthe inheritor of Purification into the courts The garden of Fadak still bears only your name\nO Zahra

arabic text: Islam ki azmat ka Ay baagh-e-sunehra\nBibi fatema zehra
english translation text: O golden garden of Islam's greatness\nLady Fatima Zahra
